Downtown Plaza.name: Downtown Plaza
Downtown Plaza.description: Historic Santa Fe Plaza core with Palace of the Governors, San Miguel Chapel, and the central mixed-use retail/hospitality corridor.

Baca Street.name: Baca Street
Baca Street.description: Baca Street corridor east of the Plaza with Victorian-era cottages, infill townhomes, and steady renovation permit activity.

South Capitol.name: South Capitol
South Capitol.description: South Capitol neighborhood with the New Mexico State Capitol, government offices, and the emerging Siler Road creative-zone mixed-use corridor.

Siler Road.name: Siler Road
Siler Road.description: Siler Road industrial-artist corridor with warehouse conversions, maker spaces, and light-industrial redevelopment.

Railyard.name: Railyard
Railyard.description: Santa Fe Railyard district with the Farmers Market, railyard parks, gallery spaces, and the Guadalupe Street retail corridor.

Eastside.name: Eastside
Eastside.description: Eastside including Canyon Road gallery district, Museum Hill, and the historic Acequia Madre neighborhood with high-value adobe renovation permits.

Casa Solana.name: Casa Solana
Casa Solana.description: Casa Solana mid-century residential neighborhood with ranch-style homes, lot splits, and steady alteration permits.

Cerro Gordo.name: Cerro Gordo
Cerro Gordo.description: Cerro Gordo foothills east of downtown with view-lot estate builds, hillside adobe construction, and National Forest adjacency.

Agua Fria.name: Agua Fria
Agua Fria.description: Agua Fria Village historic settlement west of the Plaza with agricultural-lot conversions, traditional adobe rehab, and new single-family infill.

Southside.name: Southside
Southside.description: Southside corridor along Airport Road and Cerrillos Road with master-planned subdivisions, big-box retail, and the metro's highest new-build permit volume.
